issues.reason: *Time* routes a bare when/after P with indefinite or generic participants through the whenever machinery — the trigger clause is the PREMISE, matched with plain variables, and only the response is minted as a per-occurrence Skolem event — so putting the drain bundle in the conclusion over the lone premise (Member $w wraith) inverts the construction.
The inversion makes the rule derive, for every wraith, a draining of the lanterns at strength 0.9 — the antecedent asserted as a generic fact about wraiths, which the sentence only supposes.

new_gaps: the whenever template fixes the trigger-response link as (During <response> <trigger>); a temporally ordered generic conditional (after P, Q) needs (Before <trigger> <response>) in the conclusion instead, and no rule states that substitution
defect_summary: The compliant form is the whenever rule with the trigger in the premise using plain variables — (Implication (And (Member $e drain) (Agent $e $w) (Member $w wraith) (Patient $e sk_lantern_1)) (And (Member (sk_thin $e) thin) (Experiencer (sk_thin $e) sk_harvest_1) (Member sk_harvest_1 thin) (Before $e (sk_thin $e)))) — so the draining is matched, never minted, and the same single confirmed inversion answers both issues.
notes: Referent handling is right: the definite plural lanterns as a group witness, thread_harvest with genus harvest and the noun modifier unexposed, the reified thin state with its flat copular twin, and Before rather than a connective atom for the temporal after.
